fieldNotes.ownership: IMPORTANT: This site is the former Lance / Snyder's-Lance private-label cookie/cracker plant, but it was DIVESTED to Shearer's Foods in 2014 (sale of Snyder's-Lance's private-label business) - four years before Campbell's acquired Snyder's-Lance in 2018. The current operator is Shearer's Foods (~800 employees, address 3000 Mt Pleasant St / Roosevelt Ave, Burlington IA). The roster lists it under the Campbell's account; audited as the intended physical site but it is NOT currently a Campbell's facility.
fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (40.832609, -91.14054) were ~1.2 km off in a residential area. Correct plant located via web research at 3000 Mt Pleasant St, Burlington IA - the large industrial snack building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open-access site. Driveways from Mt Pleasant Street are uncontrolled - 2016/2019 Street View shows wide open aprons with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. No perimeter fence around the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any entrance. The structure near the office front is the plant office building, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach from Mt Pleasant Street across deep paved aprons to the building.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple separate driveways onto Mt Pleasant Street serving the office, parking, and truck/dock areas.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock activity on the building's N/NE face with a few trailers visible; the wide single-story plant likely has ~15-25 doors - band 10-25, flagged uncertain (docks partly obscured / hard to count from overhead).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked on the NE side without tractors; ~10-25 band, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus a long metal-roofed warehouse to the NE on the same property; buildingCount = 2. (A separate industrial complex to the WEST and a baseball complex to the EAST are distinct properties, not part of this site.)
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Burlington IA - a small Mississippi River city; the plant is in an edge-of-town industrial/commercial area with adjacent farmland and a sports complex. Per rubric tiebreak (small-town industrial), classified Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~32 acres from perimeter box (~365m N-S x ~365m E-W).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail mainline runs along the NW edge of the property but no spur enters; railServed false.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium - the plant is positively identified and the open-access (no gate/no guard) determination is confident from Street View, but dock/trailer counts are difficult to read from overhead and the ownership is a notable data discrepancy.
